name: te5_dial_inlay
purpose: Inlaid Roman numerals, minute track and inner ring on the solid dark chapter ring (C3 inlay plane, 24.4 studs)
notes: C3 SurfaceGui Face=Back, image +y toward XII. r 1 = 12.2 studs. White 250 strokes, 2 px ink (10,10,14, 0.9). Radial numerals (tops outward, XII upright), IIII at 4 as on clock dials. Half-hour 4-point stars, tip radius 0.025.

name: te5_subdial
purpose: Engraved guilloche face of the 6.5-stud sub-dial at the clock centre (C6)
notes: C6 Face=Left. 24-circle rosette (alpha 0.85, no ink) kept off r < 0.15, which the hub stack covers anyway.

name: te5_accretion
purpose: Opaque accretion disc round the void (V2, 13-stud plane, Top GUI): Interstellar-style sheared plasma
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3: turbulence carried round at the Kepler rate (angular speed ~ r^-1.5), so every eddy is drawn out into a long trailing streak; bright filaments, hot knots, thin cool lanes and darker gaps; brightness climbs to a white-hot inner edge (L 1 inside r 0.742). Even round the disc (broad lobes divided out: the plane spins, so nothing sweeps round like a searchlight). Streaks wind CLOCKWISE outward (image +y up), as before: turn the image COUNTER-clockwise (as seen on the Top face) for trailing streaks (ACC_DIR 1). Alpha unchanged: opaque BLACK inner skirt r 0.60-0.68 (under the 8-stud core's silhouette at r 0.615), white fading into it over 0.676-0.712, opaque to r 0.86, smoothstep to 0 at r 1.0. Pure grey (R=G=B). Brightness day 1.6 / night 2.4.

name: te5_galaxy_floor
purpose: Dark galaxy pool on the dais base (D2, 29.6 studs): a barred grand-design spiral, the day-readable dark stage
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3: density-wave arms (pitch 16, sharp inner edge, gentle outer decline) made of star clouds and clusters of bright knots, braided broken dust lanes on each arm's inner edge running on along the bar as an S, faint spurs, a smooth bulge, a strong bar, an exponential disc of resolved stars (~180,000 grains) and field stars. Arms wind COUNTER-clockwise outward (image +y up), as before: a CLOCKWISE spin of the image makes them trail (spec rate -6 deg/s). Opaque to r 0.86, smoothstep to 0 at 1.0. Mean L 0.22. Pure grey. Brightness 1.3 / 2.4.

name: te5_galaxy_arms
purpose: Floating arm layer above the pool for parallax (D3, 21 studs)
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3: the same winding as the floor, turned 90 deg, pitch 13: two luminous streams of star clouds (alpha up to 1 along their cores, soft 0.2 wings), resolved stars and knots riding them, braided dust lanes (RGB 9, alpha up to 0.86) on the concave (= leading for a counter-clockwise spin) edge; alpha 0 at r < 0.13 and between the arms (mean alpha 0.18), the outer 15 % fades. The spec spins D3 at +9 deg/s against D2's -6: counter-rotating layers (strong parallax); its arms then lead rather than trail. Brightness 1.4 / 2.4.

name: te5_galaxy_core
purpose: Bright core layer under the feet (D4, 12 studs): the bulge and an inner vortex
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3: the bulge (alpha 1 to r 0.08, soft to 0.25) with a faint nuclear dust spiral; 4 arms of star clouds from r 0.1, each with its own length (0.68-0.80) and strength, broken dust lanes on their inner edges, small bright knots; alpha 0 beyond r 0.85. Same winding as the floor (COUNTER-clockwise outward). Pitch now 15 deg (was 10: from Roblox's low default camera the 10-deg arms read as concentric rings; 15 reads as a vortex). Brightness 1.5 / 2.6.

name: te5_engraving
purpose: The stage: an engraved clock ring on the ground round the dais (D5, 56 studs; review round 3, was 40)
notes: r 1 = 28 studs. From just outside the dais rim (r 0.585) to r 0.99: a fine guilloche tick band (r 0.64-0.68), Roman numerals 3 studs tall at r 0.80 with half-hour four-point stars, and an INKED minute track (a solid ink band r 0.925-0.975, alpha 1) with white ticks and lume batons every five minutes. White 240 strokes with a 2 px ink (20) outline at alpha 0.95: nothing semi-transparent. Day Brightness 1.0 (the ink carries the day), night 2.0.

name: te5_halo
purpose: Rim-only halo: moon halo billboard (15 studs), night bezel corona (C10, 44 studs) and the void's horizon glow particles (11.2 studs); its ring peaks at r 0.73, and the module scales the three by RIM_R while the pass-2 'rim' texture stands in
notes: White; alpha 0 below r 0.66, 0.95 at 0.74, 0.35 at 0.82, 0.10 at 0.90, 0 at 1.0 (monotone cubic, dithered). Tint with ImageColor3 (236,240,248).

name: te5_stream
purpose: Palm stream beams B1 (silver) and B3 (ink, via Beam Color), and the void's lensed band (B5/B6)
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3 at 512x128 (was 256x64; the same 4:1 aspect, so TextureLength / Wrap map it the same way). Image x runs ALONG the beam (seamless every 512 px, TextureMode Wrap), y across. Opaque body (alpha 1 for |v| < 0.40, 1.5 px edge, alpha 0 on the top and bottom rows) with ink edges (|v| 0.33-0.40, RGB 12): a braid of three luminous strands twisting round each other (the near half of each turn brighter), two thinner ones winding twice as fast, fine flowing striations, a darker body between them (L ~0.25-0.3). Color WHITE = a silver braided stream with ink edges (Brightness 1.6 / 2.4; lens 2.0 / 3.0); Color (18,18,24) = a solid ink stream with a faint woven structure.

name: te5_moon
purpose: Photographic full-moon face for the moon's camera-facing face disc (review round 1, AD4; rebuilt after round 3)
notes: Rendered as a lit globe, north up, the Earth-facing side: maria where the real ones are (te5_lunar_data.py; shores flooded round the old relief, ghost craters, darker and lighter lava units) at grey ~75-135, highlands ~165-195; ~26,000 craters with a power-law size spread plus 247 named ones (bowls, terraces, central peaks, ejecta); ray systems (Tycho with its dark collar and long rays, Copernicus, Kepler, Aristarchus, Proclus, Messier A, ~500 small); light 22 deg off the view axis from the upper left with lunar-Lambert reflectance and cast shadows: relief near the limb, the whole disc lit (no dark side). Hard alpha edge at r 0.985 (1.6 % ramp), no ring, no glow. Drawn whole (no ImageRect crop), ImageColor3 white. Brightness 1.25 by day; at night 2.6 clips the highland craters in the preview, 2.0 keeps them (a module choice).

name: te5_star_window
purpose: Deep-space window on the clock's solid movement plate behind the skeleton dial (review round 1, AD1)
notes: Rebuilt after review round 3: opaque near-black field (alpha 1 to r 0.985, mean L 0.07); a faint, gently curved Milky-Way band at 32 deg with star clouds, the Great Rift, branching dark filaments, globules and two faint emission clouds; ~22,000 stars with a real magnitude spread (N(<m) ~ 10^(0.4 m) over 8 magnitudes) drawn through a point-spread function (sharp core, faint halo), denser in the band and dimmed behind the dust, the 8 brightest with short diffraction spikes; ~260,000 unresolved stars as the band's grain; 34 small distant galaxies. Turns with the centre wheel (+6 deg/s). Brightness 1.1 / 2.0. Until uploaded it falls back to the pass-4 galaxy (galaxy4), drawn dimmer.
